cases.semantics: A generated document at the published logical-byte boundary is accepted and read back with its ownership marker and typed fields intact.
steps: Preflight typed NOT_FOUND and bind database configuration.
Generate payload from the bound limit catalog and record payload digest.
Read back and validate marker, fields and response shape.

cases.semantics: A minimally oversized document is rejected atomically and leaves no document.
steps: Submit a minimally oversized payload derived from the same catalog.
Record the structured refusal without retrying.
Read back and require typed NOT_FOUND.
Read exact control and require unchanged marker/digest.

cases.semantics: A nested document whose individually valid fields meet the documented nesting boundary is accepted and read back.
steps: Read back and validate canonical nested field paths and marker.

cases.semantics: A nested payload exceeding the boundary is rejected without partial publication.
steps: Read back and require typed NOT_FOUND.
Read both accepted controls and require unchanged digests.

procedure: Read each resource and verify ownership marker.
Bind exact updateTime/version before conditional delete.
Delete only owned resources with matching precondition.
Read each resource and require typed NOT_FOUND.
On uncertain read, marker mismatch or drift, stop and preserve journal.
cleanup.recovery: No unconditional delete; unresolved resources remain assigned to recovery owner.

collectorBinding.scope: REST document limit request/readback and typed post-state only
collectorBinding.technicalBlocker: No frozen production collector and no current artifact digest are bound. Production execution is prohibited until O7 supplies both.

comparatorBinding.contract: Versioned typed status/error/body, payload digest, accepted-control post-state, rejected-resource absence and cleanup outcome. Numeric timestamps are compared by semantic type/value contract, not raw bytes.
comparatorBinding.technicalBlocker: No dedicated immutable production comparison binding is frozen for this independent limits campaign.

configuration.restoration: No configuration changes are permitted; drift stops the campaign.

dependency.reason: Independent owned data namespace and no shared setting mutation.

overlapWith.resolution: Do not schedule both campaigns for production. O3 must retain these surfaces in exactly one frozen campaign; this package is the independent limits owner for FS-DATA-WRITE closure.

evidenceBoundary.local: planned shadow and local tests only
evidenceBoundary.model: limit catalog and generated payload model only

executionMode.reason: Fresh document namespace; no transaction, index, Rules or shared configuration mutation. It conflicts only with campaigns using the same nonce or owned prefix.

requiredInputs: owner identity and explicit permission reference covering this owned-data campaign
